test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the figure that will be formed when the cube is unfolded. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eefc50c7912e4e8ded525ad5a8a48424f6dd33f2a9e7a334058dfd21f15bccb5.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 2 is common on both the dice I and II, it is clear that 6, 4, 1, and 3 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 5 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d55443513456f8bbdda79c7b519c0c44d5bf577283df154cf8d508e4f946920a.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 1

4 → 3

2 → 5

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21524943738a123d7461c809a8ad223859efbb2d040e3c3e2c79b91dd053d657.png] → Can be the dice when opened, because all the sides are of adjacent sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84bae3b8b1269d965126f378bb5d5182de58705bc3943c74c267f3c19f24fc0b.png] → Cannot be the dice when opened, because the opposite pairs '3' and '4' cannot be at the adjacent sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f011c22991efc257f8dc5d807460560a9437a0a836e0d808a640d74ba5769fe.png] → Cannot be the dice when opened, because the '3' and '5' are not the required opposite pairs.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/105251f8570377e858fcff0a857e299c111ed43052f47466eb5aa4656e498b08.png] → Cannot be the dice when opened, because the opposite pairs '6' and '1' cannot be at the adjacent sides.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
